$comment: Complete configuration; every key is required and no value is a default. See configs/README.md for every key, unit and range. Units: *Nanoseconds are decimal strings of nanoseconds, *Milliseconds are integers, *Bytes are integers, degrees, feet, metres, knots. server: listenAddress host:port (loopback only here), publicBasePath mount prefix, HTTP timeouts and header bound. logging: level debug|info|warn|error, format text|json. display: field lifetimes and backend bounds. aircraftUi: browser settings; tiles null disables map tiles. source: the simulator API of configs/simulator.json (listen 127.0.0.1:18481); its timeout must not exceed display.requestTimeoutNanoseconds. transport: outbound HTTP dial, keep-alive, TLS handshake, response-header and idle timeouts and connection bounds.
